intent: Focus attention on deleting saved settings while retaining the native consequence warning and confirmation. Use one circle because the adjacent warning already explains the scope; avoid redundant floating text or an arrow to the conditional consequences paragraph.

targets.description: The existing button#delete, type=button, with aria-describedby=native-warning. Its click handler calls confirm('Delete saved settings?') and only sets saved=false when accepted.
targets.rationale: The ref attaches directly to the original button. The persistent p#native-warning explains device-local settings and retained account/documents; output#status reflects local React state. This source contains no storage or account deletion implementation. The circle is mounted only when enabled. It has no dependency on p#consequences, which is removed for destination <= 0 and replaced when its destination key changes.
